newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs dollar in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs dollar in lacklustre trade.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed unchanged against the dollar on Thursday in quiet trade, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit ended at its opening level of 155.20/25, right on the central bank bid.

"The forint stayed within a small range between 155.10 and 155.30 all day," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank. "There was some forint selling on low overnight rates which moved the forint a few pips this morning but that was all."
Overnight rates closed at 18 percent on Thursday after ending at 20 percent on Wednesday.
Butor added that a rising Ecu against the forint prompted some speculative trade.

The futures market of the Budapest Commodity Exchange (BCE) saw average turnover of 2.25 billion forints. The lion's share of trade was shared between the mark and the yen, with mark up for June and down for December and the yen up for December.
The Ecu and sterling rose for most maturities while the dollar ended mixed.
